jobs.description:
This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Our client is a global life sciences organization providing specialized research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies. The company is recognized for its scientific expertise and commitment to supporting innovation across the drug development process. The client is based in Schaerbeek.

Jobomschrijving

• Prospect and identify new business opportunities using available sales tools and market intelligence.
• Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients within your assigned territory.
• Work closely with the commercial team to execute business development strategies and support customer acquisition initiatives.
• Manage customer interactions through CRM tools, ensuring accurate follow-up, pipeline management and reporting.
• Serve as the main point of contact for prospects, understanding their needs and proposing suitable solutions.
• Respond to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner, providing information, quotations and commercial support.
• Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing and prospective accounts.
• Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions when required.
• Deliver presentations and participate in customer meetings to promote the company's products and services.
• Represent the company at selected industry events, conferences and trade shows to expand network opportunities and generate leads.
• Contribute to the growth of the business by developing new accounts and nurturing long-term customer relationships.

• BS degree in biology or life sciences related fields, or equivalent level of experience.
• Proven work experience as a sales support specialist or customer support associate.
• Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems and proficiency with MS suite incl. Excel.
• In-depth understanding and track record of best-in-class customer services.
• Excellent communication (verbal and in writing., and proficiency in English language).
• Analytical, motivational and multitasking skills.
• Teamwork and customer relationships development capabilities.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and industry events.
• A second European language is a plus.

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

Our client is an international company with various fields of expertise in the medical and pharmaceutical sector. You will work within a specific division of the company, dedicated to a field of expertise.

Jobomschrijving

 As a GL Accountant, you will work both autonomously and in support of the Chief Accountant in carrying out various tasks within statutory accounting and ensuring compliance with tax obligations:

• Daily accounting entries in AP, AR and GL
• Ensuring accuracy of all data
• Reconciliation of accounts
• Monthly and yearly closings
• Preparation and analysis of cash flow 
• Preparation of the financial statements (BE GAAP)
• Financial reporting to group
• VAT-declaration and statutory reporting NBB / Intrastat
• Assisting with external audits and internal controls
• Supporting process improvements and automation initiatives
• Acting as a point of contact within the finance team

The succesful candidate ideally matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
• 5-10 years of experience in a similar accounting role
• Strong knowledge of Belgian GAAP
• Experience in a small or medium-sized international structure is a strong asset
• Solid hands-on accounting expertise with an end-to-end view
• Fluent in English
• Good command of French (invoices and local documentation)
• Knowledge of Dutch is a plus
• Autonomous, reliable and detail-oriented
• Comfortable in a small team with broad responsibilities
• Hands-on mindset with a pragmatic and flexible attitude

Material Engineering division widely contributes to Toyota development activities from vehicle development projects to fundamental research. Our team is committed to develop solutions and to introduce attractive & environment-friendly materials towards circular economy, carbon neutrality and customer happiness.

Your responsibilities

Your profile

Proven experience as administrative assistant 

 
• 
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Rigorous and self-disciplined

As a warehouse worker for Nike ELC, you are trained to execute several tasks, such as loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing Nike products, orderpicking, labelling and packaging orders.
 

We are looking for all-round employees, who are flexible to rotate over several area’s and tasks.
 

Nike has excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience; enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important!
 

 

 
• Your knowledge of English is very good (you can find vacancies for Dutch speaking candidates on www.startpeople.be/nike)
 
• You want a full-time job and are eager to outperform during peak periods (working extended during weekends)
 
• You want to work in an early and late shift pattern (06h00-14h00 Mon-Fri, 14h00-22h00 the week after)
 
• You have your own means of transportation (the Nike campus is not accessible by bus or train)
 
• You are looking forward to having a dynamic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy orders (+/- 20 kg on a regular basis)

Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or the perfectly cooked roast beef: dishes that make your mouth water. In this role, you help make sure others can enjoy them too. In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 
Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.
• Hands-on – You are proactive, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and have strong practical insight.
• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.
• Communicative – You have good communication skills and a good command of Dutch and/or English.

What will you do?  

• Through analyzing business processes and the data that moves within them, you translate business requirements into API’s and other integration.  
• One of the tasks is to design API and other integration interfaces, analyze data structures and functionalities that need to be exposed to internal or external applications.  
• Keep track of the interface catalog and all interactions between the systems in the landscape. 
• You contribute to the development of methods and vision on actual integration challenges, technologies, and trends.  
 

Who are we looking for?  

• Knowledge of Webservices, XML/JSON, SQL, Microservices and Integration Patterns.  
• Experience with Full Lifecycle APIM tools, API Gateways, API Developer Portals…  
• You are interested in multiple middleware technologies. 
• Excellent communication skills in Dutch and English 
• Education level minimum Bachelor or equivalent through experience 
• Thrives in a hybrid environment, but is also willing to commute to Antwerp, Brussels, or Ghent on a regular basis.

the client is a leading international professional services and consulting firm that supports organisations in their digital transformation journey. Working with both local and multinational clients, you will help businesses optimise their commercial, marketing and customer service processes through innovative CRM solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale transformation programmes, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to projects that have a tangible impact on clients' business performance.

Jobomschrijving

As Salesforce Consultant, you will have the fllowing responsibilities:

• Partner with Belgian and international organisations to analyse business challenges across Sales, Marketing and Customer Service.
• Translate business needs into effective CRM solutions, supporting clients throughout their digital transformation journey.
• Lead or own specific workstreams while collaborating closely with functional and technical consultants to ensure successful project delivery.
• Participate in all phases of CRM implementation projects, including business analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post go-live support.
• Contribute to business development initiatives by supporting client proposals, presentations and commercial opportunities.
• Work within cross-functional teams in an agile project environment to deliver high-quality solutions.

• At least 3 years of experience working with Salesforce in either a functional or technical consulting role.
• Proven involvement in several CRM implementation projects from analysis through delivery.
• Good understanding of customer relationship management processes and commercial business operations.
• Ability to translate commercial objectives and business requirements into practical technical solutions.
• Familiarity with Sales, Marketing and/or Customer Service functions.
• Experience working in Agile environments is considered an advantage.
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
• Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international environments.
• Fluent in English together with either Dutch or French.
• Experience with Salesforce is essential; exposure to other enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP or Oracle is considered a plus.

The company is located in an area with no traffic jams

Jobomschrijving

What does the role involve?
	
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.	
• You precisely measure materials.

Profile – What do we expect from you?

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Jobomschrijving

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities
	
• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.	
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.	
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.	
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.	
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:
	
• Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.	
• Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.	
• Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.	
• Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.	
• Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:
	
• Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.	
• Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.	
• Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.	
• Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.	
• Able to provide good references.

Our client, based in Antwerp, is active in logistics. 

Jobomschrijving

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

Your main responsibilities:
	
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air	
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE)	
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...)	
• Receiving and processing customs documents	
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint)	
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests	
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status	
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team

Who are you?
	
• Minimum A2 diploma 	
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role	
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes	
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems	
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset	
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing	
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator	
• Able to work independently and manage priorities

jobs.occupation: Senior Full Stack Developer – Java & Angular
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern full-stack technologies.
• Deploy and manage containerized services within an Azure Kubernetes Service environment.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build data spaces and connectivity tools for regional stakeholders.
• Support the design of automated test frameworks and the integration of AI-driven development roadmaps.
• Conduct technical research and proof-of-concepts to evaluate new features for organization-wide rollout.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in backend development with Java (specifically versions 17 or 21).
• You possess 8+ years of frontend expertise with Angular and HTML5.
• You bring 5+ years of experience with Spring, Spring Boot, and Hibernate.
• You're experienced with software lifecycle tools including Git, Maven, and JUnit.
• You possess 3+ years of experience working with RESTful API and Microservices architecture.
• You have practical experience with containerization using Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
• You have advanced knowledge of Agile methodologies, ideally within a SAFe context.
• You possess a proactive and solution-oriented mindset with an interest in AI-assisted programming.
• You are native or bilingual in Dutch with professional working proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Azure DevOps and Node.js.
• Knowledge of GIS and GIS data types.
• Familiarity with UX Design & Research principles.
• Knowledge of Reactive Programming or RxJs.
• Experience with MS SQL Server and OAuth.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Scrum Master
jobs.description:
What is cream all about?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects

Like Mael, a Scrum Master at Cream, embrace your role and be involved in a large-scale IT project. Your tasks will be:

• You guarantee a smooth use of the Scrum methodology

• You are responsible for delivering and achieving the goals of the project

• You organise and facilitate all the Scrum ceremonies: the daily Scrum, the sprint planning, the retrospective meetings

• You manage the different risks of the project and remove barriers (manage interdependencies & Impediments)

• You provide assistance or support to the Product Owner concerning the Product Backlog

• You can challenge yourself in contact with technical and business teams

What do we expect from our Consultant?

• You have between 1 to 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master

• You have a good knowledge of agile methodologies. A certification is an asset.

• You have strong communication, listening & relational skills

• You are fluent in French, Dutch and English

jobs.occupation: Finance Manager - Brussels - International Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly regarded investment organisation active in early-stage technology and innovation. Based in Brussels with close collaboration across international offices, the company combines entrepreneurial spirit with institutional excellence in a modern and globally connected environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage financial operations across investment funds and corporate entities
• Coordinate fund reporting, audits and related financial processes
• Support budgeting, forecasting and financial control activities
• Monitor cash flows, capital calls and investor-related financial operations
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial, regulatory and governance requirements
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external service providers
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of finance processes and controls

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or equivalent
• Minimum 3 years of experience as Finance Manager / Finance Business Partner within venture capital, private equity, investment funds or a VC-backed scale-up environment
• Fluent in English. Fluency in Dutch is a non-mandatory asset.
• Strong understanding of financial reporting, fund structures and control processes
• Demonstrated interest in sectors such as fintech, biotech or technology-driven businesses
• Proactive communicator with a hands-on and detail-oriented mindset
